notes.title: Hello Girl's first merch is here~
notes.content: [h1]Hello Girl's first bit of merch is now up for pre-order![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409419/43b8439e1983c40d80334560b3d778459bf1b0ee.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello Girl-related merch has been requested for some time, and finally I've come up with something![/p][p]An embroidered keychain featuring Yuno can be yours~[/p][p]These come with a postcard signed by the main members of IMO Team![/p][p](Stock is limited to 50)[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://ko-fi.com/s/959bf14c50" style="button" buttoncolor="#51912f"]Order here![/url][/p][p][/p][p]Pre-orders have no pre-defined end date and will instead end when I receive the product in-hand and begin to start shipping. After which I will sell them as normal until stock runs out. Details like size and shipping costs can be seen at the store listing link above.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for supporting us and for leaving so many nice reviews ^^[/p][p]We hope to have some news about the sequel later this year![/p][p][/p][p]-Mentha[/p]

notes.title: Hello Girl Developer Commentary Stream
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=8_jMlLaCJkI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Incoming call![/b]

The three main developers will play through Hello Girl and chat about its development, while answering your questions.

[h2]When stream[/h2]

[b]The live stream took place on Friday, March 14th, 6pm PST.[/b] It has now concluded.

[h2]Recording[/h2]

An edited VOD of the live stream is [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8_jMlLaCJkI]available on YouTube[/url].
